about: Mini-games with few pieces (feature F6; PLAN WP 7.6): one idea at a time, played against a bot. Each has a start position, the side the owner plays, and a goal checked by code after every move.

games.name: Pawn war
games.idea: Pawn races: count the moves to the last rank, and use your king
games.about: Kings and pawns only. The first to make a queen wins.

games.name: Queen against pawns
games.idea: A queen stops pawns from in front and from the side; take the free ones first
games.about: Your queen against eight pawns. Win them all before one of them becomes a queen.

games.name: Two-rook mate
games.idea: The ladder: one rook holds a rank, the other gives check on the next
games.about: Checkmate their king with your two rooks, within twenty moves.

games.name: King and rook mate
games.idea: Push their king to the edge with your rook, and bring your own king up to help
games.about: Checkmate with a king and a rook, within forty moves.
